Subject: Circling back after SF AI — inference priorities?

Hi Emily — great meeting you at the SF AI Summit yesterday. Thanks again for taking five minutes on the expo floor to chat about BrightSide's latency-sensitive recommendation pipeline. Quick recap and suggested next steps so nothing falls through the cracks:

- What I heard: 1) P50 target ~ 60ms for small text prompts, 2) sustained batch throughput for nightly reranks, 3) tight security requirements (VPC + audit logs).
- What Redwood can bring: hosted API to start, with an easy path to Dedicated pools for predictable throughput; we can provide an SLA and example cost banding for both streaming and batch jobs.

Next steps I suggest:
1) 30-min tech sync (demo of a similar prepacked pipeline + quantization options)
2) Share a short SLA + example pricing bands so your procurement can triage

I attached the SF_AI_deck.pdf that shows a sample configuration and a baseline latency/cost chart for models similar to the ones you mentioned. Are you available next week for a quick demo? I can do Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks — happy to coordinate times with Samir if he wants to join.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
